name: merge-array-union-tags
comment: Arrays compare whole, not element by element (see the corpus README and kdb/json/diff.go), so a field-diff-driven merge like merge-disjoint-fields.json cannot pick this apart itself. A procedure that wants the union has to read both arrays and build it, sorting first so the two engines - and the two nodes running this - land on the same element order regardless of goja's vs GraalJS's iteration order over an object used as a set.
